'''2017 US Nationals Vikram Bali LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2017 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Vikram Bali]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125443/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive]
